messages:
Lina (Growth): flagging the weekly KPI deck - paid_conversions jumped 35% yesterday but spend didn't change. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Tom (Ads): whoa saw PPC CPC stable. our ad platform shows no bid/volume changes. could be tracking issue.
Ben (Analytics): running quick check. initial guess: duplicate conversions from a redirect we've been A/B testing on the landing page. pasting query I used:
```
SELECT conversion_date, count(distinct lead_id) as unique_leads, count(*) as raw_conversions
FROM conversions
WHERE conversion_date = '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY conversion_date;
```
Ben (Analytics): raw_conversions = 1,420 vs unique_leads = 1,050 -> ~35% duplicates.
Sofia (Content): that matches the new variant where we added an intermediate redirect to /r/landing-promo for tracking.
Tom (Ads): we pushed a JS redirect last week for click attribution. maybe it's firing twice for some users (redirect loop)?
Ben (Analytics): digging into event logs. pattern: same click_id (gclid) appears across 1.3k events, but duplicate conversion events have identical click_id and slightly different timestamps (2-5s apart) and different landing_url query params. looks like both the final page and the redirect are firing the conversion pixel.
Lina (Growth): so conversions counted on both the redirect and the final page. rough fix = dedupe by click_id in the dashboard. long fix = remove conversion ping on redirect.
Ben (Analytics): quick SQL patch we can use in dashboards now: `SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(click_id, lead_id)) as deduped_conversions`
MarketingBot: alert: dashboard-pipeline shows a surge in conversion_events at 1756901300. auto-notify sent to #eng-analytics.
Tom (Ads): I'll roll back the redirect ping in the A/B variant now. reducing noise ASAP.
Sofia (Content): hold any launch copy referencing record CVR for the promo. we need normalized numbers.
Ben (Analytics): I'll push a staging panel with deduped numbers and a small compare table: raw vs deduped vs spend-normalized. ETA 45m.
Lina (Growth): also add a tiny note on the KPI slide: 'Conversion deduplication applied (by click_id) to account for redirect double-pings.' keeps comms honest.
Tom (Ads): rollback complete at 1756901305. removed pixel from /r/ redirect.
MarketingBot: dashboard-staging deploy queued by Ben at 1756901350.
Ben (Analytics): staging updated at 1756901450. deduped conversions = 1,052 which aligns with spend. panels: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/panels/1789/compare.png
Sofia (Content): thanks. I'll update the narrative to: "Cohort-normalized conversion lift; initial raw reporting overstated due to duplicate tracking pings from an A/B redirect."
Lina (Growth): long term: Ben, can we add a validation rule: if raw_conversions / deduped_conversions > 1.05, open ticket to investigate?
Ben (Analytics): yep adding MGMT-3180 to backlog and a lightweight alert to the pipeline.
Tom (Ads): I'll add a QA step to the A/B rollout checklist to verify no duplicate pixel firings (simple headless test).
Lina (Growth): great. Immediate action items: 1) Ben - keep staging panels live and share final slides 2) Tom - confirm rollback in prod and QA 3) Sofia - hold language until updated slide deck 4) MarketingBot - include a deploy note on the KPI deck.
MarketingBot: note added to KPI-deck: redeploy at 1756901475.
Sofia (Content): circulating updated slide deck in #marketing-review now. small copy tweak and transparent footnote included.
Lina (Growth): nice catch team. closing thread once the deck is accepted. :white_check_mark:
